subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenant controls and next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fastcart.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.legal@fastcart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenant controls and next steps

Hi Samir / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a short recap to make sure we captured the pain, current stack, and concrete next steps so both teams are aligned. Please tell me if I missed anything.

1) Primary pain points you shared
- Unpredictable tenant-level spikes causing noisy neighbor effects on inference costs and tail latency
- Current gateway only supports coarse server-level throttling; need per-customer quotas and rate-limiting
- No automated routing to dedicated capacity for high-tier customers (manual ops work today)
- Billing/usage visibility is fragmented — hard to reconcile infra metrics with invoices

2) Current stack (as discussed)
- API gateway + Kong in front, Keycloak for auth; per-tenant metadata stored in Postgres
- Currently using third-party hosted LLM endpoints (vendor X) for generation; considering move to Redwood Dedicated for predictable performance
- Logging to Splunk, billing data in Stripe; want usage metering surfaced to billing team

3) Success criteria for a pilot / POC
- Enforce per-tenant request quotas with per-minute and per-day limits
- Automatic routing: tier="premium" tenants routed to dedicated capacity with p95 latency <= 200ms for inference requests at 32-token avg load
- Audit logs and per-tenant traceability for compliance (needed for procurement)
- Integration point for billing export (CSV / webhook) that aligns with Stripe items

4) Constraints and must-haves
- Data residency: US-only (primary workloads in us-east-1)
- SOC 2 evidence + simple security questionnaire answers for procurement
- Pilot must fit into a 6-week timeline if possible

5) Next steps (owner / ETA)
- Neha: Share Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and security questionnaire by EOD Mon (attached) — 2027-03-22
- FastCart (Samir): Confirm 2 pilot tenants and provide sample tenant IDs + expected QPS — by 2027-03-26
- Redwood (Marcus): Schedule technical deep-dive with infra (routing, quotas, KV cache) — propose Wed 2027-03-24
- Both: Align on pilot success metrics and rollback policy during tech deep-dive

Attachments: 20270322-FastCart-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), FastCart-security-questionnaire.xlsx

If this looks good I'll send a calendar invite for the deep-dive and drop the MAP into the shared folder.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samir Patel <samir@fastcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.legal@fastcart.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: multi-tenant controls and next steps

Neha — thanks for the clear summary. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed pain: the noisy neighbor spikes usually show up as bursty background jobs + customer-initiated catalog builds; we need per-tenant protections that can be both rate-based and token-budget-based.
- Routing: ideally routing should be policy-driven (e.g., tenant.metadata.tier == 'enterprise' -> dedicated cluster). Manual ops today is a blocker.
- Billing: we can provide a sample export from Stripe but would prefer a webhook so usage lines map directly to invoice items.

Questions: 
1) How does Redwood handle graceful degradation when dedicated capacity is saturated? Is automatic fallback to a lower-cost model acceptable?
2) For the audit logs — do you support tenant-scoped immutable logs we can ship to our S3?

Timeline: we can confirm pilot tenants by 2027-03-26. We are aiming for a POC start in the first week of May (internal approvals + procurement).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, FastCart
samir@fastcart.com | +1 (212) 555-0128

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding the FastCart discovery recap. Key commercial notes:
- Opportunity size: mid-market to enterprise with clear expansion to other product lines (cart personalization)
- Procurement will want SOC2 + tenant-level auditability; they asked about billing webhook mapping to Stripe
- Timeline: they want POC in ~6 weeks; ideal POC start early May after approvals.

Can we approve a pilot discount (15% off list for first 3 months of pilot) to tighten timeline? Marcus, can you confirm resources for a dedicated pilot cluster (1 GPU pool + tech deep-dive) if we get the approval?

Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fastcart.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.legal@fastcart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 18:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: multi-tenant controls and next steps

Samir / Jordan — quick follow-up and confirmation of next steps after your note earlier today.

1) Graceful degradation: Redwood supports policy-driven fallbacks. For the pilot we recommend the following policy: primary route -> dedicated capacity; fallback -> standard quantized model variant (lower-cost) + reduced token budget. We'll include this in the MAP and define SLOs for acceptable fallbacks.

2) Audit logs: yes — tenant-scoped immutable logs can be exported to customer-owned S3 (we'll provide a signed bucket-transfer workflow and prefixing by tenant_id).

Confirmed plan & deadlines:
- MAP + security questionnaire: delivered (attached) — action: please review and add tenant IDs by 2027-03-26
- Tech deep-dive: proposed 2027-03-24 at 10:00 AM PT — I will send invite once Marcus confirms
- Pilot start window: target week of 2027-05-03, contingent on PO and access to 2 pilot tenants

Deliverables from Redwood for the POC:
- Dedicated pilot capacity (1 GPU pool) with routing policies configured by tenant metadata
- Per-tenant quota enforcement and billing export (CSV + webhook)
- Audit log export to customer S3
- Post-POC performance report (latency, cost delta, hit rates)

If that all aligns, I'll drop the MAP into the shared Drive link and we can lock tech deep-dive time.

Attachments: 20270322-FastCart-MAP-v1.pdf, FastCart-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
